fullPassage: We are living in the age of connectivity driven by the permeating and relatively inexpensive and proliferated wireless broadband, fastest-growing mobile technology, and social media mediated peer-to-peer communication. As a result, marketing is changing with the power of authentic, relevant, and experiential storytelling. Social media is shifting the power from marketers to consumers where the stories told by the consumers themselves are often more potent than the ones told by the brands. Authentic storytelling does not use rational and emotional communication as a means of manipulation; instead, it uses the power of storytelling honestly and sincerely to connect with the customer at a deeper level. Authentic storytelling invites customers on a transformational journey through a rational message wrapped in emotion. "A well-told story captures our attention, holds us in suspense, and pays off with a meaningful emotional experience." A well-told brand story uses characters through whose eyes the customer can see the world and be empathetic for the character. Customers therefore can relate to the character. Through demonstrating the day-to-day life challenges of their customers, strong brands hold their hands as a mentor rather than the hero.

✅ ① age of connectivity ... wireless broadband ... social media, 일치
✅ ② captures our attention, holds us in suspense, and pays off with a meaningful emotional experience, 일치
❌ ③ 궁극적 목적이 조종 → does not use ... as a means of manipulation, 반대 ←정답(불일치)

ch: 우리는 무선 통신과 소셜미디어가 이끄는 연결성의 시대에 살고 있다.
잘 만든 이야기는 주의를 끌고 긴장감을 유지하며 의미 있는 감정적 경험으로 보답한다.
진정성 있는 스토리텔링의 궁극적 목적은 소비자를 조종하는 데 있다.
고객은 등장인물의 눈으로 세상을 보며 그 인물과 관계를 맺을 수 있다.

questions.passage: We are living in the age of connectivity driven by the permeating and relatively inexpensive and proliferated wireless broadband, fastest-growing mobile technology, and social media mediated peer-to-peer communication. As a result, marketing is changing with the power of authentic, relevant, and experiential storytelling. Social media ①<u>is shifting</u> the power from marketers to consumers where the stories ②<u>told by the consumers</u> themselves are often more potent than the ones told by the brands. Authentic storytelling does not use rational and emotional communication as a means of manipulation; instead, it uses the power of storytelling honestly and sincerely to connect with the customer at a deeper level. Authentic storytelling invites customers on a transformational journey through a rational message wrapped in emotion. "A well-told story captures our attention, holds us in suspense, and pays off with a meaningful emotional experience." A well-told brand story uses characters ③<u>through which eyes</u> the customer can see the world and be empathetic for the character. Customers therefore can relate to the character. Through ④<u>demonstrating</u> the day-to-day life challenges of their customers, strong brands hold their hands as a mentor rather than the hero.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 등장인물의 '눈'은 그 인물이 소유한 것이므로 소유의 관계대명사 whose가 필요하다. which는 소유격이 아니므로 through which eyes는 틀리다.
det.analysis:
① is shifting — Social media is shifting: 현재진행형, 정상
② told by the consumers — the stories told by the consumers: 과거분사 수동 수식, 정상
③ through which eyes — 원문 through whose eyes, characters의 '눈'(소유) → 소유격 관계대명사 whose 필요 ←정답
④ demonstrating — Through demonstrating: 전치사 + 동명사, 정상
det.tip: 소유 관계: through whose eyes (등장인물의 눈) — which ✕

"소셜미디어는 힘을 마케터로부터 소비자에게로 옮기고 있다."

[조건] (1) Social, consumers, from, is, marketers, media, power, shifting, the, to 를 모두 사용
       (2) 정확히 10단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '옮기고 있다'는 현재진행형 is shifting, '~로부터 ~에게로'는 from A to B로 나타낸다.
det.analysis:
주어 Social media → is shifting(현재진행) → the power → from marketers to consumers(마케터로부터 소비자에게로).

단계별로: 무엇이 옮기나 → Social media, 무엇을 → the power, 어떻게 이동 → from marketers to consumers. 그래서 'Social media is shifting the power from marketers to consumers'(10단어)가 된다.
det.tip: 현재진행형 is shifting + from A to B

questions.wa: Social media is shifting the power from marketers to consumers
accept: Social media is shifting the power from marketers to consumers
